column1: # Example: Helicobacter pylori ATCC 43629 proteins modulated over time in outer membrane vesicles released by biofilm and by planktonic cultures (6 days and 10 days versus 2 days).

# Source: Puca V, Marinacci B, Pagotto S, Krzyzek P, Di Cintio F, Pellegrini B, Pietrangelo L, Ronci M, Grande R. (2026) Characterization of Helicobacter pylori Outer Membrane Vesicles over time, in biofilm and planktonic phenotypes. Front Microbiol 17:1765988. https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2026.1765988

# Table 4, "List of proteins modulated between the Biofilm and Planktonic phenotypes identified by proteomic analysis". Cutoff as stated by the paper: identified in at least 33% of the replicates, significance >= 20 and fold change >= 1.5, giving 45 proteins in the biofilm and 123 in the planktonic phenotype; rows collapsed to 131 unique names (thousands separators in the HP numbers removed). Licensed CC BY; values as published.

# Columns: protein = gene symbol in the LIVIA Atlas Helicobacter pylori 26695 index, mapped from the table's gene name or HP number (unmapped rows keep the name as given); uniprot = index accession; name_in_table as given; phenotype = the section of the table; ratio_6d_vs_2d and ratio_10d_vs_2d = the table's ratios.
# 104 of 131 proteins map to the index (79%).
